videos.description:
World of Warcraft players spent twelve years convinced there was a secret quest for the Ashbringer. The sword was in the game's files with no way to get it, and the game kept dropping clues: a fishing book with only its last page, an elf prince who wanted a dragon's head, and a useless item called Timolain's Phylactery. A corrupted Ashbringer turned up in Naxxramas in 2006, Tirion Fordring purified the real one in 2008, and in Legion (2016) Blizzard finally built a secret quest out of those exact clues. Part of my Debug Mode series on video game history.

The Reins of the Spectral Bear is a Legacy System reward at 55 Legacy Points. You earn points from 65 challenges: levelling each class to 25, 45 and 60, professions to 150/225/300, PvP, dungeons and raids. Blizzard says a single character can earn up to 29 points, so the bear needs alts. Along the way: Spectral Bear Cub pet at 25 points and the tabard at 40.
